papers.title: Discourse Diversity in Multi-Turn Empathic Dialogue

training_data.name: 322 multi-turn emotional-support conversations filtered from WildChat and SENSE-7
training_data.quote: Our training data comes from two complementary sources of real user–LLM interactions: WildChat (Zhao et al., 2024) and SENSE-7 (Suh et al., 2026). From both corpora, we retain only English-language conversations with at least 3 turns. The resulting dataset contains 322 multi-turn emotional-support conversations totaling 1,719 supporter turns.

training_data.name: WildChat
training_data.quote: WildChat is a collection of 1 million conversations between human users and ChatGPT.

training_data.name: SENSE-7
training_data.quote: The dataset is provided in sense-7_dataset.xlsx. Messages: Role: user/assistant.

source_claims.quote: We evaluate Mint on two base policy models, Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B (Yang et al., 2025).

description.text:
This model is the **Q + D_KL** MINT checkpoint fine-tuned from [Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B) for multi-turn empathic dialogue.

MINT, short for **Multi-turn Inter-tactic Novelty Training**, is a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes empathic response quality together with cross-turn discourse-move novelty. At the 1.7B scale, this checkpoint provides the strongest aggregate empathy performance among the MINT variants reported in the paper.

output_type.quote: This model is the **Q + D_KL** MINT checkpoint fine-tuned from [Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B](https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-1.7B) for multi-turn empathic dialogue.

use_claim.quote: This model is intended for research on empathic dialogue, discourse diversity, and supportive response generation.

warning.quote: It is a research artifact, not a therapy system, and at the 1.7B scale the main improvement is empathy quality rather than a substantial reduction in tactic repetition.

serving.text_only_input_quote: prompt = "Give me a short introduction to large language model."
serving.notes: The parent card runs that text prompt through AutoModelForCausalLM. This repo's own usage example only loads the weights. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; the template is chat_template.jinja and it does not set a system string. generation_config.json has no max_new_tokens or repetition_penalty. config.json max_position_embeddings is 40960; the parent card says context length 32,768; tokenizer model_max_length is 131072. Hub safetensors total is 2,031,739,904 parameters. The upload commit names this file global_step_190.

evaluation_reported.text: On the Lend-an-Ear test set (315 supporter turns, 50 conversations), aggregate empathy improves from 3.60 to 4.54 relative to vanilla Qwen3-1.7B. Table 2 tactic stickiness is 0.51 for both the vanilla baseline and this Q + D_KL checkpoint.
